guide.text: Ordinary and held-out subscription facts are synthetic stress scenarios, not representative customer behavior or real adopter usage evidence. The long-text browser clone is a separate synthetic stress input, distinct from the manifest fixture entries and the CadenceSubscriptionFacts.held_out!/1 source. This disposable, non-production review lab presents a static review surface. Rendered controls do not establish completed billing actions. Static rendering verifies story state and visual/semantic output. It does not prove mounted authorization, provider completion, dispatched action behavior, or persistence. The held-out stress input represents typical customer behavior.

story.moduledoc: Every variation is a static render of deterministic scenario facts. It does not establish mounted authorization, provider completion, persistence, or action success.

entries.job: understand subscription state and choose a supported next action

held_out.documentation: Returns separately labelled held-out text stress input, never an ordinary variation.
held_out.function_block:
def held_out!(:long_text) do
  |> Map.put(:lane, :held_out)
  |> Map.put(:held_out_case, :long_text)
end

ordinary.refusal: scenario must declare the ordinary review lane

browser_evidence.function_block: return { theme, label: "held-out long text (not manifest fixture)" };
browser_evidence.label: held-out long text (not manifest fixture)
